fieldNotes.location: Roster gave '2001 Bilter Rd, Aurora IL 60502' with coords (41.806642,-88.267623). The roster point itself is a residential strip; ~250m south sits a large warehouse/packaging facility with an office annex and a big trailer yard, in the 60502 (NE Aurora) area - consistent with the roster. CCP operates TWO Aurora facilities (Hormel says so); the web-listed 3777 Exchange Ave (60504) is the other one. Audited the building at ~41.8047,-88.2709 as the roster-intended site.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard is enclosed by chain-link fencing (visible in Street View), but the driveway entrances appear to be open gate gaps with no barrier arm and no staffed booth. No controlled checkpoint identified - marked false at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at any entrance. A canopy/carport structure on the NE side is an equipment shelter, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: East building face has trailers backed in along a dock bank; estimated ~14-18 doors visible plus more. Total estimated 10-25 band (~22). Estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer drop yard - a south-yard row of ~20+ parked trailers plus additional rows along the east. dropArea 25-50 band; many trailers branded for outside fleets (Penske rental, beverage brands), consistent with a contract-packaging logistics yard.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved yard and open driveway aprons give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Aurora is part of the Chicago metropolitan area; the site has a major retail/mall complex immediately south and dense suburbs to the west, though farm fields border it north and west. Judged Urban (metro fabric) - flagged as borderline given the edge-of-development setting.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main warehouse/packaging building plus an attached office annex - counted as 2 structures, one integrated facility.

citations.claim: Hormel Our Locations: CCP started by Hormel Foods in 1998 in Aurora IL; 120+ people across two production facilities.
Hormel Form 10-K Exhibit 21 lists Creative Contract Packaging Corp. as a Hormel subsidiary in Aurora IL.

verification.rationale: CCP is a Hormel-owned subsidiary started by Hormel in 1998, still Hormel-operated (120+ employees); not co-pack-only; no negative.
